preconditions.description: The grid size n is an integer between 2 and 100 inclusive.
In each turn, Alice's chosen color a is an integer 1, 2, or 3.
The game consists of exactly n^2 turns, filling the entire grid.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= b <= 3 and b != a for (a, b) in zip(alice_colors, bob_colors))
postconditions.description: For every turn, Bob's chosen color b is in {1, 2, 3} and differs from Alice's color a.

postconditions.expression: len(set(bob_positions)) == n * n and all(1 <= i <= n and 1 <= j <= n for (i, j) in bob_positions)
postconditions.description: Bob places exactly n^2 tokens, each in a unique valid cell (i, j) within the grid bounds.

postconditions.expression: all(grid[i][j] != grid[ni][nj] for i in range(1, n+1) for j in range(1, n+1) for ni, nj in [(i-1, j), (i+1, j), (i, j-1), (i, j+1)] if 1 <= ni <= n and 1 <= nj <= n)
postconditions.description: The final grid contains no conflicts: no two adjacent cells share the same color.
